statement:
A New Series Exploring Womanhood and Inner Discovery. Find Yourself is a new body of work centered on women and the emotional landscapes they navigate. Each piece captures a moment of introspection—an invitation to look inward amidst a world of constant motion.

Through surreal forms and dreamlike settings, the series reflects on identity, resilience, and the quiet strength found in self-awareness. These figures, adorned with cosmic crowns and flowing silhouettes, become symbols of transformation and presence. Rooted in both personal and universal experience, Find Yourself invites you to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the deeper truths within.
